The system stores energy by compressing CO2 into a liquid state and releases it through a turbine to generate electricity when needed, with a capacity of up to 24 hours.
Following the launch of its first commercial plant in Sardinia in 2025, the company is planning 30 gigawatt-hours of projects across five continents.

backlog.summary:
Researchers at Syracuse University, Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg, and TU Dresden published a technical paper titled “RAPID: Row-Parallel Arithmetic Processing in DRAM.” Abstract Excerpt: “Processing-using-memory (PUM) architectures perform computation directly within DRAM to reduce costly data movement between memory and processors. Because charge-sharing operations are confined to individual bitlines, existing DRAM-PUM architectures reorganize data into column-oriented, bit-serial... » read more
The post Row-Parallel DRAM Computing Cuts Data-Reorganization Overhead (Syracuse, FAU, TU Dresden) appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: The RAPID architecture introduces row-parallel arithmetic processing within DRAM to eliminate the costly data-reorganization overhead typical of existing processing-using-memory (PUM) designs.
By adding migration and inversion cells to DRAM subarrays, the system enables horizontal data movement and logical operations without converting data to bit-serial formats.
This approach preserves CPU-compatible, word-parallel layouts, allowing for more efficient integration of in-memory computing with conventional processor architectures.

A monolithically integrated... » read more

bullets: Researchers have demonstrated a monolithically integrated memristor-TFT stack that enables electrically programmable temporal dynamics for reservoir computing.

Geely joins other Chinese manufacturers like Dongfeng in targeting the Canadian market, leveraging the new quota system to expand its international presence.

backlog.title: Job titles of the future: Delivery drone air traffic controller
backlog.summary: The moment Trevor Wischnewsky heard that drones were delivering pizza and sushi around his Texas neighborhood, his mind was made up. “It was super fascinating,” he says. “I just immediately wanted to be a part of it.” Wischnewsky is now an RPIC, or “remote pilot in command,” at a company called FlyTrex. An RPIC is…
bullets: The rise of commercial drone delivery is creating a new professional class of 'remote pilots in command' (RPIC) who manage fleets of autonomous aircraft.
These operators utilize Unmanned Aircraft Systems Traffic Management (UTM) networks to coordinate flight paths between competing companies, ensuring collision avoidance beyond the line of sight.

The role requires a blend of traditional aviation certification, technical proficiency in sensor monitoring, and the ability to manage multiple autonomous units simultaneously under variable weather conditions.

backlog.title: Nio completes nearly 1.2 million battery swaps over 7-day holiday, sets daily record twice
backlog.summary:
Nio's 4,168 battery swap stations completed 1,192,221 swaps from October 1 to 7, with the daily average rising 22% year-on-year.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Nio completed nearly 1.2 million battery swaps during the 7-day National Day holiday, with daily average usage rising 22% year-on-year.
The company set a new daily record of 183,664 swaps on October 5, demonstrating the scalability of its energy replenishment network during peak travel.
Highway-specific infrastructure played a major role, with Nio's highway stations supplying over 24.83 million kWh of electricity, a 30.8% increase from the previous year.
The data highlights the growing reliance on battery swapping for long-distance travel, with over 200,000 users opting for this method exclusively during their holiday trips.
